title: CMS Test: Publishing From Fernandes Journeys
excerpt: A quick publish check from the new in-site CMS — safe to delete after we confirm GitHub + Vercel are wired up.
contentHtml:
This is a CMS publish test for Fernandes Journeys. If you can read this on the live blog after Publish, the passcode login, GitHub commit, and Vercel deploy path are all working.

What this checks

  • Unlocking /cms with the passcode
  • Writing a post JSON file to GitHub
  • Vercel rebuilding so the story appears under /blog

You can delete this post from the CMS (or from GitHub) once the test succeeds.
